WITH web_dispatch AS (
    SELECT web_order_id,
           CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
    FROM fact_web_order
    WHERE status IN ('delivered', 'collected')
),
net_lines AS (
    SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, s.store_id, f.net_amount AS net_sales, 'sale' AS kind, f.sales_line_id AS id
    FROM fact_sales_line f
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
    JOIN web_dispatch w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT r.return_date, s.store_id, -r.refund_net, 'ret', r.return_line_id
    FROM fact_return_line r
    JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = r.store_key
    JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = r.product_key
    WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT n.business_date, SUM(n.net_sales) AS net_sales,
       SUM(CASE WHEN kind='sale' THEN net_sales ELSE 0 END) AS gross_before_returns,
       COUNT(*) AS nrows, COUNT(DISTINCT kind||id) AS ndistinct,
       (SELECT net_sales FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date=n.business_date) AS rpt_net,
       (SELECT net_sales_before_returns FROM rpt_daily_store_sales r WHERE r.store_id=900 AND r.business_date=n.business_date) AS rpt_before
FROM net_lines n
WHERE n.business_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT o.*, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', order_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS od
  FROM fact_web_order o
)
SELECT 'orders_by_dispatch' AS chk, CAST(dd AS VARCHAR) AS k, status, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(line_count) AS lc, NULL AS x
FROM o WHERE dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-13' AND DATE '2025-12-25' GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'dup_lines', 'receipt_id+line_no', NULL, COUNT(*), COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)), COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id WHERE o.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'orders_no_lines', NULL, o.status, COUNT(*), NULL, NULL
FROM o WHERE o.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.receipt_id=o.web_order_id) GROUP BY 1,3
ORDER BY 1,2,3;

WITH o AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dd
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT 'web_lines_by_store' AS chk, CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR) AS k, p.category = 'ZZ Test' AS is_test, COUNT(*) AS n, SUM(f.net_amount) AS amt
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE o.dd BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23' GROUP BY 1,2,3
UNION ALL
SELECT 'store900_lines_not_in_web_orders', CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR), NULL, COUNT(*), SUM(f.net_amount)
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-10' AND DATE '2025-12-24'
  AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM o WHERE o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id) GROUP BY 1,2
UNION ALL
SELECT 'returns_on_web_lines_by_return_store', CAST(s.store_id AS VARCHAR), NULL, COUNT(*), SUM(r.refund_net)
FROM fact_return_line r JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
WHERE r.return_date BETWEEN DATE '2025-12-15' AND DATE '2025-12-23'
  AND r.sales_line_id IN (SELECT sales_line_id FROM fact_sales_line f WHERE f.channel_code='WB' OR f.receipt_id IN (SELECT web_order_id FROM fact_web_order))
GROUP BY 1,2
ORDER BY 1,2,3;
